text: The economic crisis of the early 1990s was severe.
In 1991, the recession deepened across manufacturing.
By 1995, GDP growth returned to positive.
The early 1990s saw major bank failures.
The late 1990s brought the dot-com boom.
The 2000s opened with a tech sector correction.
Housing prices soared during the mid-2000s.
Central banks kept rates low through 2018.
In 2020, the pandemic caused economic shock.
